from_statement: AUTHOR-PROVED AUXILIARY RESULT, independent review pending. For s>0, finite signed Borel measures nu,mu supported in B(0,a),B(0,b) with zero total mass, and |z|>a+b, the absolute interaction integral of |z+x-y|^{-s} is at most s(s+1) M1(nu)M1(mu)(|z|-a-b)^{-s-2}, where M1(nu)=integral |x|d|nu|(x).
to_statement: A finite signed Borel measure nu on R^3 is neutral when integral dnu=0. With finite first absolute moment it is dipole-free when integral x dnu(x)=0. Define Mp(nu)=integral |x|^p d|nu|(x), where |nu| is its total variation. For a charge centered at c use x-c in the moment definitions; for a neutral charge the dipole is independent of c.

relation.rationale: L1 uses the defined zero-mass and M1 conditions.
